title: Different behaviour of pow(tensor, bool) for CPU vs CUDA

labels.name: module: cuda
labels.description: Related to torch.cuda, and CUDA support in general

labels.name: module: error checking
labels.description: Bugs related to incorrect/lacking error checking

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: edge cases
labels.description: Adversarial inputs unlikely to occur in practice

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

```python
In [52]: torch.pow(torch.tensor([1, 2]), True)
Out[52]: tensor([1, 2])

In [53]: torch.pow(torch.tensor([1, 2], device='cuda'), True)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RuntimeError                              Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In[53], line 1
----> 1 torch.pow(torch.tensor([1, 2], device='cuda'), True)

RuntimeError: false INTERNAL ASSERT FAILED at "/home/isuruf/git/pytorch/aten/src/ATen/native/cuda/PowKernel.cu":199, please report a bug to PyTorch. invalid combination of type in Pow function, common dtype:Longexp is integral?0
```
